name: Haus Josephine
beschreibung: The Haus Josephine enjoys a quiet position on the edge of Serfaus on Tyrol's renowned sunny plateau. The bright, friendly rooms and holiday apartments are decorated with natural wood furnishings, featuring modern bathrooms, complimentary Wi-Fi, and private balconies overlooking the majestic Samnaun mountain range. A short walk brings visitors into the pedestrianised village centre and to the convenient Serfaus Dorfbahn underground railway, providing seamless connections to the main cable car terminals. In summer, the Serfaus-Fiss-Ladis plateau is a dream destination for hiking and mountain biking, while in winter, it ranks among the premier ski expanses in the Alps.
kurzbeschreibung: Cosy accommodation in Serfaus on the Tyrolean sunny plateau featuring scenic alpine views and proximity to the village underground.
